description: ai-ecoverse/slicc-jsh#1104: an uncaught non-Error value from a queueMicrotask callback prints Node 22.22.0's header for a microtask, <anonymous_script>:0 and an empty line, or task_queues' runMicrotasks for the piped stdin script's own microtasks, from -e, stdin, a timer and CommonJS and ES module files; and a thrown value whose stack getter throws prints as Node does: an object as its String() (from the script, alone), a value with a name and a message, and an Error as name: message after the arrow, always with the --trace-uncaught hint (stderr as JSON strings)
